decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the About-page copy and retains only the continuing Small Block prize.
The existing MODIFY removes the Big Block counter and lifecycle keys but leaves BIG_BLOCK in the no-referral ticket allocation, which is incompatible with eliminating Big Blocks.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hey Joseph, id like to eliminate the big blocks and give that extra $1 to me, so it'll be:
$15 buy, $5 to me,  $5 to affiliate,  $5 to block prize pool.

Increases my bottom line with minimal impact on sales.
Plus it simplifies the game mechanics and marketing.

Giveing myself and each community member an even split, as well as everyone getting an even shot at the never ending $500 prizes seems aligned with the projects ethos.

decisions.reason: The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the $5 founder allocation, $5 Small Block pool allocation, and removal of Big Block as a pool destination.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already limits the no-referral reward to the $5 commission and a Small Block ticket.
Eliminating Big Blocks does not change the general rule that active prize tickets transfer with the NFT; the remaining Small Block tickets still satisfy that rule.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already revises the Mission-page prize copy to advertise only continuing Small Block prizes.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already limits selection eligibility and scope to Small Block while preserving the unchanged Chainlink VRF selection method.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already records the new $5 primary-mint contribution to the continuing Small Block prize pool.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already removes Big Block from the secondary-sale prize-pool destinations, while the source does not change the secondary-sale founder share or royalty amount.
The existing message-195 MODIFY already deletes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter metadata key.
Eliminating Big Blocks does not change the automatic wallet-transfer collection flow for the continuing Small Block prizes.
The prize-mechanics and primary-revenue decision does not change the Transak provider, supported payment methods, conversion, fulfillment, or deferred lifecycle.
